## Peachy Pitt

Peachy Pitt is the pale-green unicorn mare who sells Pinkie Pie a banner for Rainbow Dash’s party in *Friendship Is Magic*. She began as season-one animator Erica Pitt’s own pony character and subsequently appeared in the G4 TV continuity.

She has a very pale lime coat, orange-and-gold mane and tail, and green eyes. Erica’s original design had black-framed glasses, “sassy” eyebrows and a peach-half cutie mark; the glasses and cutie mark are not visible in her *Pinkie Pride* scene. There she wears a striped vendor shirt and a broad-brimmed hat.

**Naming and speech.** The name “Peachy Pitt” comes from her creator, not from a fan nickname; handwriting on a [2011 signed character drawing](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2011/08/signed-pony-from-fim-animators.html) was initially misread by some fans. The episode credits call her *Banner Vendor*, while Enterplay’s licensed 2014 *Crystal Games* card #89 names her **“Peachy Pitt, Suave Salesmare.”** She has speaking lines in *Pinkie Pride*, voiced in English by **Tabitha St. Germain**. Her documented TV appearances are *Friendship Is Magic, Part 2* (S1E2; crowd), *Pinkie Pride* (S4E12), and *On Your Marks* (S6E4). [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Peachy_Pitt).

## Important moments

- **The biggest banner — *Pinkie Pride* (S4E12).** She asks Pinkie what she needs and magically supplies the biggest banner for Rainbow Dash’s celebration: her defining speaking scene. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=95R4diMuWOU); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Painting Tree Hugger — *On Your Marks* (S6E4).** She is seen painting a portrait during “Out On My Own,” revealing an artistic side to the familiar shopkeeper. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O3PtyzwcsUE); scene timestamp unavailable.
